            special flashlight feature where the back glows. overall good budget phone
            I've bought it early april and now I've used it for more than a month. Update: I liked the phone a lot. Now it's February 2026 and i bought another one for my friend and no complaints. The ram plus doesn't make much difference but 4gb internal ram(not including ram plus)is good enough for me and very light gaming. The battery is really good for me who usually browses instagram and within an hour of use approx 10% of battery is used up which is fine for me. The camera quality isn't that good so don't buy if you are a photographer. there's no charging brick so i use an old samsung 5v 1.5A charger and takes like an hour to charge from 50-80%. You might need an adaptor to change from usb c to normal usb to use the cable inside There's both fingerprint and face unlock. The sim card holder can hold two sim cards or one sim card and one sd card. I will update this post when I've used it for a year. If you're someone who's not familiar with buying phones online and exchanging read carefully: For exchange, you need the phone you want to exchange its IMEI and go for exchange but make sure you don't add to cart but click buy so that you can check if the exchange is available. If it takes you to the payment section, exchange is available in your area. Make sure you factory reset the phone first and then fill up the space in your phone with movies or videos till 100% storage and then reset your phone again. You'll have to login with a Gmail account that's not important with no personal information and then download rabbit exchange on playstore and log out of gmail. Make sure you have wifi or hotspot during exchange For buying the phone, make sure you watch unboxing videos and check the imei after buying from Amazon . i suggest you take screenshots of the videos and compare the screenshots and imei from Amazon. Make sure you check where the seals are Do check how a phone should look when turning on for the first time. It should have a welcome or hello screen or something similar. When delivery driver comes, check all of these points and turn on the phone but don't put sim card in yet until you are happy with the phone. Check camera, speaker or what is important to you. You can ask chatgpt for help too. If you aren't free at home, ask a friend or someone trusted to check the phone for you and record the delivery if possible and if some defects happen, reject the delivery. Sometimes sellers give you second hand even though you asked for a new product, so do check during delivery. Most delivery persons are patient in my experience as long as you're not annoying and waste their time. Make sure you create a list of what to check to not waste time It's also a good idea to buy a phone cover and tempered glass

              I've bought it early april and now I've used it for more than a month.

              Update: I liked the phone a lot. Now it's February 2026 and i bought another one for my friend and no complaints.

              The ram plus doesn't make much difference but 4gb internal ram(not including ram plus)is good enough for me and very light gaming.

              The battery is really good for me who usually browses instagram and within an hour of use approx 10% of battery is used up which is fine for me.

              The camera quality isn't that good so don't buy if you are a photographer.

              there's no charging brick so i use an old samsung 5v 1.5A charger and takes like an hour to charge from 50-80%. You might need an adaptor to change from usb c to normal usb to use the cable inside

              There's both fingerprint and face unlock.

              The sim card holder can hold two sim cards or one sim card and one sd card.

              I will update this post when I've used it for a year.

              If you're someone who's not familiar with buying phones online and exchanging read carefully:

              For exchange, you need the phone you want to exchange its IMEI and go for exchange but make sure you don't add to cart but click buy so that you can check if the exchange is available. If it takes you to the payment section, exchange is available in your area.

              Make sure you factory reset the phone first and then fill up the space in your phone with movies or videos till 100% storage and then reset your phone again.

              You'll have to login with a Gmail account that's not important with no personal information and then download rabbit exchange on playstore and log out of gmail.

              Make sure you have wifi or hotspot during exchange

              For buying the phone, make sure you watch unboxing videos and check the imei after buying from Amazon . i suggest you take screenshots of the videos and compare the screenshots and imei from Amazon. Make sure you check where the seals are

              Do check how a phone should look when turning on for the first time. It should have a welcome or hello screen or something similar.

              When delivery driver comes, check all of these points and turn on the phone but don't put sim card in yet until you are happy with the phone.

              Check camera, speaker or what is important to you. You can ask chatgpt for help too.

              If you aren't free at home, ask a friend or someone trusted to check the phone for you and record the delivery if possible and if some defects happen, reject the delivery.

              Sometimes sellers give you second hand even though you asked for a new product, so do check during delivery. Most delivery persons are patient in my experience as long as you're not annoying and waste their time. Make sure you create a list of what to check to not waste time

              It's also a good idea to buy a phone cover and tempered glass

              If you aren't free at home, ask a friend or someone trusted to check the phone for you and record the delivery if possible and if some defects happen, reject the delivery.

              Sometimes sellers give you second hand even though you asked for a new product, so do check during delivery. Most delivery persons are patient in my experience as long as you're not annoying and waste their time. Make sure you create a list of what to check to not waste time

              It's also a good idea to buy a phone cover and tempered glass

                I just got the phone today on amazon sale for 8k the 4+128 varient.

                Build Quality & In Hand Feel - 1st The build quality is very bad, the back panel is flimsy, on light pressure it dips, don't think it can survive drops more than 10 or 20.

                However the in hand feel is quite good, the phone is not very much wide but tall so gripping the phone is easy, and the phone is light and weight distribution is very good so it feels very light in hand.

                Multimedia - Though the display is 720P LCD panel the display looks very good colors are also very good the display feels responsive it's a very beautiful panel to look at in this price segment, it supports 1440 p video on YouTube but no HDR and I didn't check it on Netflix or some other apps.

                The phone has a bottom firing single speaker the sound quality is quite good for the price it's not very loud and not very sharp, nor very bassy but I would say it's decent.

                Conectivity - I tested this device on Wi-Fi, on 2.4 Ghz Wi-Fi signal i got only HALF of the speed, but in 5 Ghz I got the Full speed of 80 MBPS connection which I have.

                I tested this phone with bsnl 4G and I got good speech while my moto g52 got 12 to 13 MBPS speed I got near about 17 to 18 MBPS speed on this, call quality is okay there was no problem.

                Performance & UI - when I was setting up the phone on it was very laggy and stutured very much though it was installing background apps on its own and got very warm. After the I said the phone aside for a while and the phone become cool and it runs smoothly there was no issue after that, the apps open closed very smoothly, there is no leg or jitter, The fingerprint is bit slow but ok for the price nothing to complaint. If there is anything important I will update it later. I didn't bother to check the camera as my mother is going to use this phone at that doesn't very important to her.

                There were few bloatwares and some Samsung apps which I uninstall and disabled some of them after that the phone became clean and I turned of the glance lock screen and set the dynamic wallpaper lock screen so there was no add or something.

                Camera- This phone clicks okay photos, But it supports Camera2Api, With Gcam photos are significantly better, can be compared to a14-15K phone.

                Conclusion - as my mother is going to use this phone so the build quality is not that big issue, it has good display for the price decent sound quality and smooth operation, this is the cheapest and best 5G phone at this price with smooth and clean UI experience, and it comes with 4 years of software update, show the banking apps will not stop in near future atleast for 5-6 years. If the phone not dies before that.

                So the phone is very good deal for parents or if you use it for multimedia experience or moderate use, And use very carefully not dropping the phone, which I do a lot.
